tree.heading: Applicability of Certain Provisions Relating to Compensation.—
tree.text: The provisions of this title specified in subsection (b) apply with respect to benefits and assistance under this chapter in the same manner as those provisions apply to compensation paid under chapter 11 of this title.

tree.heading: Specified Provisions.—
tree.text: The provisions of this title referred to in subsection (a) are the following:

children.text: Subsection (a) and paragraphs (1), (6), (9), and (10) of subsection (b) of section 5112.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 1832 was renumbered section 3732 of this title. Another prior section 1832 was renumbered section 3733(d) of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2015—Subsec. (b)(2). Pub. L. 114–58 substituted “(b)(3)” for “(b)(2)”. 2003—Pub. L. 108–183 renumbered section 1822 of this title as this section.
